# **II. Software Requirement Specification**

## **1\. Product Overview** {#1.-product-overview}

The Farmely Urban Farming Management System is a new software platform that digitizes and replaces the traditional manual, fragmented processes for leasing agricultural plots, managing cultivation services, and tracking crop progress in owner-operated urban farms. The context diagram below illustrates the external entities and system interfaces for Release 1.0. The system is expected to evolve over several releases, ultimately connecting to physical IoT automated irrigation systems, real-time banking payment gateways, and agricultural e-commerce logistics services.

![][image2]

## **2\. User Requirements** {#2.-user-requirements}

### ***2.1 Actors***

*An actor represents a role played by a human user, an external software system, or a hardware device that interacts directly with the Farmely platform. Based on the system boundaries, the identified actors are categorized below:*

* *Who is notified when events occur: Customers (IoT alerts, task sync), Field Workers (new task dispatches), Agricultural Experts (field issues), Administrators (cancellations, overdue tasks).*  
* *Who provides information or services: Agricultural Experts (agronomic templates), Field Workers (yield measurements, photo evidence), IoT Stations (telemetry), Weather API (forecasts), Payment Gateway (transaction callbacks).*  
* *Who helps respond to and complete tasks: Field Workers (on-site farming execution), Payment Gateway (financial settlement), AI Service (informational farming Q\&A).*

| \# | Actor | Type | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Customer (KH) | Primary (Human) | Authenticated urban tenant who selects and rents farm plots via Master Lease Agreements, chooses crop varieties, monitors plant growth through IoT telemetry and webcams, purchases care packages, and accepts harvested produce. |
| 2 | Agricultural Expert (CGNN) | Primary (Human) | Agronomy specialist who formulates standard crop cultivation processes, configures safe environmental thresholds, answers pre-rental and active tenant consultations, and provides technical guidance during field issues. |
| 3 | Field Worker (CVLĐ) | Primary (Human) | On-site farm technician who receives daily care tasks, performs physical cultivation (watering, fertilizing, weeding), uploads mandatory on-site photo evidence, and weighs/records final harvest yields. |
| 4 | Administrator (AD) | Primary (Human) | Operational manager responsible for managing system users, land sectors, plot configurations, IoT device bindings, pricing rules, and reviewing contract cancellations/refunds. |
| 5 | Guest / Visitor | Secondary (Human) | Unauthenticated visitor exploring the public marketplace, reviewing plot specifications, and scheduling physical farm inspection tours. |
| 6 | Payment Gateway | External System | Third-party financial gateway (VietQR / Banking Mock) that processes 100% upfront lease payments, collects service fees, and executes authorized refunds. |
| 7 | IoT Sensor Station | Hardware Device | On-plot hardware microclimate station providing real-time soil moisture, ambient temperature, and air humidity readings every 10–180 minutes. |
| 8 | Weather Service | External System | External meteorological service (OpenWeatherMap API) providing local weather forecasts to trigger automatic watering task postponements during rainfall. |
| 9 | AI Knowledge Service | External System | External LLM engine that powers the 24/7 informational agricultural assistant using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over farm knowledge documents. |

### **2.2 Use Cases** {#2.2-use-cases}

*All use case names strictly adhere to the standard `[Verb] + [Object]` naming convention, clearly reflecting direct, measurable value delivered to the system actors.*

#### ***2.2.1 Diagram(s)***

The Farmely system use cases are decomposed into two focused architectural views:

1. **Figure 2.2.1-1: Customer & Master Lease Subsystem Use Case Diagram**  
Illustrates the tenant lifecycle: farmland discovery, site tour booking, multi-plot Master Lease configuration with a 10-minute Grace Period, independent plot monitoring, automated farm diaries, and harvest handover.  
*(Diagram reference: `docs/diagrams/uc_01_customer_master_lease.png`)*

2. **Figure 2.2.1-2: Farm Operations, Agronomy & Administration Subsystem Use Case Diagram**  
Illustrates the back-office and on-site workflows: Agricultural Specialists formulating standard process templates, Field Workers executing prioritized care tasks with mandatory photo evidence (without material tracking), scale-photo harvest logging, and automatic 4-day soil fallow governance.  
*(Diagram reference: `docs/diagrams/uc_02_operations_farmely.png`)*

#### ***2.2.2 Descriptions***

| ID | Use Case | Actors | Use Case Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| UC01 | Register Customer Account | Guest | Allows visitors to sign up for a customer account by verifying email and phone uniqueness and securely hashing passwords. |
| UC02 | Authenticate User Login | All Users | Authenticates credentials, validates active account status, issues JWT session tokens, and redirects users to role dashboards. |
| UC03 | Book On-Site Inspection Tour | Guest, Customer | Enables visitors to schedule a physical farm visit (morning or afternoon slot) with basic contact details before committing to a lease. |
| UC04 | Browse Farmland Marketplace | Guest, Customer | Allows users to view, search, and filter available plots by sector, area, compatible crop types, and monthly rental price ceilings. |
| UC05 | Configure Master Lease Agreement | Customer | Enables tenants to select multiple plots, pick compatible certified crop varieties and cultivation modes per plot, apply a 15-minute lock, and generate a unified lease agreement. |
| UC06 | Process Upfront Lease Payment | Customer, Payment Gateway | Collects 100% upfront lease balance through VietQR/gateway with an automatic 10-minute Grace Period extension upon checkout load. |
| UC07 | Renew Active Lease Contract | Customer, Payment Gateway | Allows tenants to extend an active lease for 1–3 months before the 3-day deadline without disrupting soil history or garden diaries. |
| UC08 | Request Contract Cancellation and Refund | Customer, Administrator, Payment Gateway | Processes early termination requests, applies tiered deduction rates (20% or 50% prior to start), and submits refund tickets for administrative disbursement. |
| UC09 | Formulate Standard Agronomy Process | Agricultural Expert | Allows specialists to establish standardized cultivation workflows with milestone day offsets, care instructions, and safe environmental boundaries. |
| UC10 | Track Cultivation Roadmap | Customer, Agricultural Expert | Displays real-time crop growth roadmap, including task completion milestones and field worker verification photos. |
| UC11 | Execute Daily Care Task | Field Worker | Displays assigned daily care tasks, allows workers to view technical instructions, upload on-site photo proof, and mark tasks as completed. |
| UC12 | Submit Field Issue Report | Field Worker | Allows field technicians to log crop anomalies (pests, disease, irrigation failure) with photos directly to the assigned expert. |
| UC13 | Monitor Microclimate Telemetry | Customer, Expert, IoT Station | Displays near-real-time sensor readings (temperature, humidity, soil moisture) and 24-hour historical trend charts for leased plots. |
| UC14 | Synchronize Automated Farm Diary | Customer, Field Worker | Automatically creates diary entries with photos when assisted care tasks are completed; allows self-growing tenants to write manual posts. |
| UC15 | Record Harvest Yield Weight | Field Worker | Records actual crop weight using an electronic scale, uploads digital scale readout photos, and logs the worker's staff ID. |
| UC16 | Inspect and Accept Harvest Produce | Customer | Allows tenants to verify harvest photos and yields, confirm acceptance, and select on-farm pickup or home delivery options. |
| UC17 | Consult Agricultural Specialist | Customer, Agricultural Expert | Provides a 1-on-1 communication channel for tenants to ask questions, share plant photos, and receive agronomic guidance. |
| UC18 | Query Farming Knowledge Assistant | Customer, AI Service | Provides 24/7 informational answers to general agricultural inquiries using RAG over the farm's indexed technical document library. |
| UC19 | Purchase Delegated Care Package | Customer, Payment Gateway | Allows self-growing tenants to order à-la-carte services or purchase temporary 30-day full-care packages during busy periods. |
| UC20 | Manage Farmland Plots and Maintenance | Administrator | Manages land sectors, plot dimensions, IoT station bindings, and oversees the automatic 4-day soil fallow cycle before plots reopen. |
| UC21 | Administer Users and Access Permissions | Administrator | Manages user accounts, assigns internal staff roles, and reviews system audit logs. |

**Role Legend:**

**\- KH (Customer): Rents plots, participates in cultivation, and monitors progress remotely.**

**\- CGNN (Agricultural Expert): Provides technical expertise, designs cultivation processes, and offers consultation.**

#### ***3.1.4 Non-Screen Functions***

| \# | Feature | System Function | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Authentication | Authentication and Access Control | Verifies credentials, account status, role permissions, and access to requested records. |
| 2 | Authentication | Password Reset Email | Generates a time-limited reset link and sends it to the registered email address. |
| 3 | Plot Rental | Booking Validation | Checks variety compatibility, minimum cultivation duration, plot availability, and conflicting rental schedules. |
| 4 | Plot Rental | Price Calculation | Calculates upfront rental and care charges for multi-plot leases and additional care services (no separate material tracking). |
| 5 | Plot Rental | Reservation Expiration | Releases unpaid reservations after 15 minutes, with an additional 10-minute Grace Period when checkout loads (PAYMENT_PENDING). |
| 6 | Payment | Mock Payment Processing | Records payment transactions and activates contracts without duplicate processing. |
| 7 | Contract Management | Contract Lifecycle Processing | Confirms paid contracts, activates them at 00:01 on start date, and completes unrenewed leases at 23:59 on end date. |
| 8 | Contract Management | Renewal Processing | Validates the 3-day renewal deadline and forward plot availability, then creates a linked continuation contract. |
| 9 | Contract Management | Refund Calculation | Calculates an 80% (>= 3 days prior) or 50% (< 3 days prior) refund before the start date according to cancellation policy. |
| 10 | Plot Management | Maintenance Scheduling | Automatically blocks plots for a fixed 4-day soil recovery and tilling period after lease completion before reopening to AVAILABLE. |
| 11 | Care Management | Automatic Task Generation | Generates care tasks at 05:00 AM from standard process templates for Assisted-growing contracts and active care packages. |
| 12 | IoT Monitoring | Sensor Simulation and Validation | Generates readings every 3 hours, filters invalid environmental anomalies, and records threshold alerts. |
| 13 | Weather Integration | Weather Data Retrieval | Retrieves local weather forecasts every 3 hours and safely handles third-party service outages. |
| 14 | Alert Management | Alert Evaluation and Routing | Detects prolonged moisture breaches (> 30 min) and automatically creates emergency tasks for Assisted plots or push alerts for Self-growing plots. |
| 15 | Care Management | Watering Task Postponement | Automatically postpones scheduled watering when heavy rain is forecast or soil humidity reaches at least 80%. |
| 16 | Task Management | Overdue Task Detection | Automatically marks unfinished tasks as OVERDUE after 23:59 and alerts the Administrator. |
| 17 | Task Management | Completion Validation and Diary Synchronization | Requires on-site photo evidence before completion and automatically synchronizes finished tasks to the customer's Farm Diary. |
| 18 | Technical Support | Intervention Application | Associates expert-issued technical guidance with affected plots and field operational instructions. |
| 19 | Communication | Message Polling | Retrieves authorized customer–expert and worker–expert messages through 5-second polling intervals. |
| 20 | AI Assistance | Knowledge Indexing and Response Generation | Indexes approved agronomy documents and answers customer farming inquiries using RAG without retaining state across sessions. |
| 21 | Notification | Notification Generation | Creates in-app notifications for payments, contracts, assignments, IoT alerts, services, and harvest sign-offs. |
| 22 | File Management | Upload Validation | Enforces image size limits (max 5 MB) and validates allowed formats (JPEG/PNG). |
| 23 | System Monitoring | Audit Logging | Records administrative operations and status changes with actor, timestamp, and target entity IDs. |
| 24 | Reporting | Summary Aggregation | Computes dashboard KPIs (occupancy rates, active contracts, overdue tasks) scoped to the requesting role. |

### ***3.1.5 Entity Relationship Diagram***

#### **Entities Description**

| \# | Entity | Description |

| 1 | users | Stores all system user accounts across roles (Customer, Expert, Worker, Admin). |

| 3 | plots | Individual rental plots with dimensions, pricing, IoT device codes, and status. |
| 4 | crops | Approved agricultural crop species (e.g., leafy greens, roots). |

| 7 | contracts | Master Lease Agreements defining tenant tenure, total upfront price, and lifecycle status. |
| 8 | contract_plots | Contract line items mapping physical plots to chosen varieties and cultivation modes. |
| 9 | payment_transactions | Audit logs of all financial transactions (payments, refunds, gateway refs). |
| 10 | cancellation_requests | Tenant lease termination tickets with calculated deduction and refund amounts. |
| 11 | process_templates | Standard agronomic cultivation workflows formulated by Agricultural Experts. |
| 12 | template_steps | Specific care milestones (watering, fertilizing) defined by day offsets. |
| 13 | care_tasks | Actionable field tasks assigned to Field Workers with priority and status. |
| 14 | farm_diaries | Chronological growth diary posts auto-synced from completed tasks or logged by self-growers. |
| 15 | sensor_readings | Microclimate time-series telemetry (soil moisture, temperature, humidity) linked to plots. |
| 16 | issue_reports | Anomaly tickets logged by workers or tenants for specialist guidance. |
| 17 | harvest_results | Final yield weight records with digital scale photos and customer acceptance flags. |
| 18 | services | Master catalog of à-la-carte care services and temporary 30-day delegated care packages. |
| 19 | service_requests | Tenant purchases of additional care services linked to a specific plot. |
| 20 | site_visits | Prospective lead inspection bookings for scheduled morning/afternoon farm tours. |
| 21 | messages | In-app 1-on-1 consultation chat messages between tenants/workers and specialists. |

### **3.2 Account Management and Public Services**

#### ***3.2.1 Customer Registration (SCR-PUB-02)***

**Screen ID:** SCR-PUB-02

**Actor:** Guest / Unauthenticated Visitor

**Function Trigger:** An unauthenticated visitor clicks "Register" on the top navigation bar or selects "Sign up" on the login page. Routes to /register.

**Function Description:** Enables prospective customers to register a personal account. Validates inputs, verifies identity uniqueness, creates a record in users with ROLE\_CUSTOMER, and activates the account. Internal roles (Admin, Agricultural Expert, Field Staff) are provisioned directly by Administrators.

##### **Screen Layout**

**Figure 3.2.1-1: Customer Registration Screen Mockup (SCR-PUB-02)**

*(Screen layout placeholder \- To be inserted from design)*

##### **Function Details**

***Field Descriptions:***

| \# | Field Name | Control Type | Required | Constraints & Format | Default Value | DB Mapping |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Full Name | Text | Yes | 2–100 characters. Trim whitespace | None | users.full\_name |
| 2 | Email Address | Email | Yes | Valid RFC 5322 format, unique | None | users.email |
| 3 | Phone Number | Tel | Yes | 10 digits starting with 0 (^0\[0-9\]{9}\$), unique | None | users.phone\_number |
| 4 | Password | Password | Yes | Min 8 chars, \>= 1 uppercase, \>= 1 lowercase, \>= 1 digit | None | users.password\_hash |
| 5 | Confirm Password | Password | Yes | Must match Password field value exactly | None | Client/Server only |

***Validation Rules:***

| Rule ID | Field Name | Validation Rule |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| V1.1 | Full Name | Required. 2 to 100 characters. Trim leading/trailing whitespace. |
| V1.2 | Email Address | Required. Valid email regex (RFC 5322). Must not exist in users.email. |
| V1.3 | Phone Number | Required. Must match regex ^0\[0-9\]{9}\$ (10 digits starting with 0). Must not exist in users.phone\_number. |
| V1.4 | Password | Required. Minimum 8 characters with at least one uppercase, one lowercase, and one numeric character. |
| V1.5 | Confirm Password | Required. Must match Password field value exactly. |

***System Messages:***

| Message ID | Condition | Content | Message Type |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| M1.1 | Duplicate email detected | "This email address is already registered." | Inline Error |
| M1.2 | Duplicate phone detected | "This phone number is already registered." | Inline Error |
| M1.3 | Password policy failed | "Password must contain at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numbers." | Inline Error |
| M1.4 | Passwords mismatch | "Passwords do not match." | Inline Error |
| M1.5 | Registration complete | "Account created successfully. Please sign in." | Toast (Success) |

***Business Rules & Processing Logic:***

**Main Operational Flow:**

* Visitor accesses /register via navigation link or login screen prompt.  
* System presents registration form.  
* Visitor submits Full Name, Email, Phone Number, Password, and Confirm Password.  
* System validates syntax and database uniqueness (V1.1 to V1.5).  
* Server hashes the password with bcrypt (work factor 12).  
* System inserts a new user record with role\_id \= 1 (ROLE\_CUSTOMER) and status \= 'ACTIVE'.  
* System displays success toast M1.5 and redirects to /login.

**Alternative / Exception Flow:**

* If validation fails or duplicate credentials exist, display corresponding inline error messages (M1.1–M1.4) without clearing valid inputs.

**Business Rules:**

* Passwords are encrypted server-side using bcrypt (work factor 12\) before database insertion.  
* New accounts default to role\_id \= 1 (ROLE\_CUSTOMER) and status \= 'ACTIVE'.  
* Successful registration redirects the user to /login.

#### ***3.2.2 User Login (SCR-PUB-03)***

**Screen ID:** SCR-PUB-03

**Actor:** All System Users (Guest, Customer, Agricultural Expert, Field Staff, Administrator)

**Function Trigger:** A user clicks "Log In" on the navigation bar or is redirected by a protected route guard. Routes to /login.

**Function Description:** Authenticates user credentials across all system roles. Verifies the password hash, issues an HTTP-only JWT cookie, and routes to role-specific dashboards.

##### **Screen Layout**

**Figure 3.2.2-1: User Login Screen Mockup (SCR-PUB-03)**

*(Screen layout placeholder \- To be inserted from design)*

##### **Function Details**

***Field Descriptions:***

| \# | Field Name | Control Type | Required | Constraints & Format | Default Value | Notes |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Email Address | Email | Yes | Valid email format | None | Login identity (users.email) |
| 2 | Password | Password | Yes | Non-empty string | None | Checked against bcrypt hash |
| 3 | Remember Me | Checkbox | No | Boolean | False | Extends session validity from 2 hours to 14 days |

***Validation Rules:***

| Rule ID | Field Name | Validation Rule |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| V2.1 | Email Address | Required. Must be formatted as a valid email address. |
| V2.2 | Password | Required. Non-empty string. |

***System Messages:***

| Message ID | Condition | Content | Message Type |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| M2.1 | Authentication failure | "Incorrect email or password." | Inline Error |
| M2.2 | Inactive or suspended account | "Your account is deactivated. Please contact the administrator." | Modal Alert |
| M2.3 | Login success | "Welcome back, {full\_name}." | Toast (Success) |

***Business Rules & Processing Logic:***

**Main Operational Flow:**

* User navigates to /login.  
* User inputs Email Address and Password, optionally selects Remember Me, and clicks "Log In".  
* System verifies non-empty input and checks credentials against users table via bcrypt verification.  
* System confirms account status \== 'ACTIVE'.  
* System generates an HTTP-only JWT token with expiration (2h default, 14d with Remember Me).  
* System shows toast M2.3 and redirects based on user role:  
  * ROLE\_CUSTOMER \-\> /customer/dashboard  
  * ROLE\_EXPERT \-\> /expert/dashboard  
  * ROLE\_STAFF \-\> /staff/dashboard  
  * ROLE\_ADMIN \-\> /admin/dashboard

**Alternative / Exception Flow:**

* If email not found or password incorrect, return generic message M2.1 to prevent account enumeration.  
* If account is SUSPENDED or INACTIVE, display modal alert M2.2 and deny access.

**Business Rules:**

* Failed attempts return a generic message to prevent account enumeration.  
* Accounts marked SUSPENDED or INACTIVE cannot authenticate.  
* Role redirection: ROLE\_CUSTOMER \-\> /customer/dashboard, ROLE\_EXPERT \-\> /expert/dashboard, ROLE\_STAFF \-\> /staff/dashboard, ROLE\_ADMIN \-\> /admin/dashboard.

* If unauthenticated, customer\_id is stored as NULL.

* Farm visit is optional and not a prerequisite for renting a plot.

#### ***3.3.2 Master Lease Agreement Configuration (SCR-KH-04)***

**Screen ID:** SCR-KH-04

**Actor:** Authenticated Customer (KH)

**Function Trigger:** An authenticated customer selects one or more plots from the marketplace and clicks "Proceed to Agreement". Routes to /contracts/create.

**Function Description:** Configures a Master Lease Agreement across multiple plots. For each plot, the user selects a certified crop variety and cultivation mode. Checks duration bounds, applies a 15-minute reservation lock, and totals upfront fees.

##### **Screen Layout**

**Figure 3.3.2-1: Master Lease Agreement Configuration Mockup (SCR-KH-04)**

*(Screen layout placeholder \- To be inserted from design)*

##### **Function Details**

***Field Descriptions:***

| \# | Field Name | Control Type | Required | Constraints & Format | Default Value | DB Mapping |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Leased Plots | Multi-select | Yes | Minimum 1 plot in AVAILABLE state | Selected plots | contract\_plots.plot\_id |
| 2 | Start Date | Date | Yes | \>= Today \+ 3 days (prep buffer) | Today \+ 3d | contracts.start\_date |
| 3 | End Date | Date | Yes | \>= Start Date \+ maturity duration \+ buffer | Computed | contracts.end\_date |
| 4 | Variety per Plot | Dropdown | Yes | Must exist in plot\_crop\_compatibility | None | contract\_plots.variety\_id |
| 5 | Cultivation Mode | Radio | Yes | SELF\_GROWING or ASSISTED\_GROWING | SELF\_GROWING | contract\_plots.cultivation\_mode |
| 6 | Service Package | Dropdown | Conditional | Required if mode is ASSISTED\_GROWING | Standard Care | contract\_plots.service\_id |
| 7 | Terms Acceptance | Checkbox | Yes | Must be checked | False | System gate |

***Validation Rules:***

| Rule ID | Field Name | Validation Rule |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| V5.1 | Compatibility | Variety must exist in plot\_crop\_compatibility for that specific plot. |
| V5.2 | Lease Duration | Must satisfy: (end\_date \- start\_date) \>= (varieties.expected\_duration \+ varieties.buffer\_time). |
| V5.3 | Overlap Check | Target plots must have no active leases or unexpired reservations in the requested window. |

***System Messages:***

| Message ID | Condition | Content | Message Type |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| M5.1 | Duration too short | "Lease period must be at least {days} days for {variety\_name}." | Inline Error |
| M5.2 | Collision lock | "Plot {plot\_code} was just reserved by another customer. Please choose an alternate plot." | Modal Alert |
| M5.3 | Lock confirmed | "Plots held for 15 minutes. Proceeding to checkout." | Toast (Info) |

***Business Rules & Processing Logic:***

**Main Operational Flow:**

* Customer selects plots and configures variety, cultivation mode, and dates for each plot.  
* Customer checks Terms Acceptance and clicks "Submit Agreement".  
* System validates constraints V5.1–V5.3.  
* System creates agreement in contracts and line items in contract\_plots.  
* Plots are placed in status \= 'RESERVED' with 15-minute lock expiration.  
* System shows toast M5.3 and redirects to /checkout/{contractId}.

**Alternative / Exception Flow:**

* If any plot was reserved by another user in the interim, display collision alert M5.2.

**Business Rules (BR03, BR04, BR05, BR08, BR09):**

* A single agreement (contracts) covers multiple physical plots via contract\_plots.  
* Customer signs once and pays once for the combined balance.  
* Plots enter RESERVED status for 15 minutes.  
* Baseline seeds and potting soil are bundled into lease rates; material inventory is not tracked separately.

#### ***3.3.3 Contract Payment and Grace Period Processing (SCR-KH-05)***

**Screen ID:** SCR-KH-05

**Actor:** Authenticated Customer (KH)

**Function Trigger:** Arrives automatically from SCR-KH-04 upon contract submission. Routes to /checkout/{contractId}.

**Function Description:** Collects the 100% upfront lease balance through the payment gateway. Adds a 10-minute Grace Period extension to the reservation timer when checkout loads.

##### **Screen Layout**

**Figure 3.3.3-1: Contract Payment Screen Mockup (SCR-KH-05)**

*(Screen layout placeholder \- To be inserted from design)*

##### **Function Details**

***Field Descriptions:***

| \# | Field Name | Control Type | Required | Constraints & Format | DB Mapping |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Contract ID | Integer | Yes | Valid contract reference | contracts.contract\_id |
| 2 | Total Payable | Decimal | Yes | Extracted from contract total | contracts.total\_price |
| 3 | Payment Method | Radio | Yes | VIETQR, CARD, MOCK\_BANKING | Stored in payment transaction |

***Validation Rules:***

| Rule ID | Field Name | Validation Rule |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| V6.1 | Channel Selection | Must select an active payment gateway channel. |
| V6.2 | Active Window | Payment confirmation must occur before the grace countdown expires. |

***System Messages:***

| Message ID | Condition | Content | Message Type |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| M6.1 | Timer expired | "Reservation window expired. Plots have been released." | Modal Alert |
| M6.2 | Payment successful | "Payment confirmed. Contract is active." | Toast (Success) |

***Business Rules & Processing Logic:***

**Main Operational Flow:**

* On page load, contracts.status becomes PAYMENT\_PENDING, extending reservation timer by 10 minutes (Grace Period).  
* Customer selects payment method and executes payment.  
* Payment gateway returns success callback.  
* System creates record in payment\_transactions, sets contracts.status \= 'CONFIRMED', and moves plots to RENTED.  
* On contracts.start\_date, status automatically switches to ACTIVE.  
* System displays toast M6.2 and redirects to Customer Dashboard.

**Alternative / Exception Flow:**

* If timer expires before payment, plots revert to AVAILABLE and contract is marked CANCELLED (M6.1).

**Business Rules (BR08, BR09):**

* 100% upfront payment required; no deposit. 10-minute grace period applies once per reservation.

**Function Trigger:** A tenant clicks "Cancel Contract" on an active or confirmed lease. Routes to /contracts/{contractId}/cancel.

**Function Description:** Processes lease termination requests. Calculates refund deductions based on advance notice, logs the request in cancellation\_requests, and queues it for admin approval.

| 2 | Cancellation Reason | Textarea | Yes | 10 to 500 characters | cancellation\_requests.reason |
| 3 | Deduction Rate | Percent | Auto | 20%, 50%, or 100% | cancellation\_requests.deduction\_rate |
| 4 | Refund Amount | Currency | Auto | total\_price \* (1 \- deduction\_rate) | cancellation\_requests.refund\_amount |

***Validation Rules:***

| ----- | ----- | ----- |

| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |

***Business Rules & Processing Logic:***

**Main Operational Flow:**

* Tenant opens cancellation form, reviews calculated deduction rate and refund amount.  
* Tenant enters reason (\>= 10 chars) and bank disbursement details, then submits.  
* System validates inputs (V8.1, V8.2) and logs record in cancellation\_requests.  
* System displays confirmation modal M8.2 and alerts Administrator.  
* Upon Admin approval, refund transaction is logged in payment\_transactions, contract is terminated, and plots enter 4-day soil maintenance.

**Business Rules (BR10):**

* Notice \>= 3 days before start: 20% penalty deduction, 80% refund.  
* Notice \< 3 days before start: 50% penalty deduction, 50% refund.  
* Notice on or after start date: 100% deduction, 0% refund.  
* Terminated plots transition to 4-day maintenance before reopening.

**Business Rules (BR13, BR14, BR15):**

* Workers must move tasks to IN\_PROGRESS before completing them. Marking a task COMPLETED requires uploading at least one photo. No material inventory tracking is required. Tasks remaining unfinished by 23:59 are flagged as OVERDUE by a nightly job, alerting the Administrator.

## **4\. Non-Functional Requirements** {#4.-non-functional-requirements}

### **4.1 External Interfaces** {#4.1-external-interfaces}

This section describes how the Farmely system communicates with its users and with external hardware or software elements.

#### **User Interfaces**

* **Customer Web Application:** A responsive web application built with ReactJS and TailwindCSS, accessible via modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari). The interface supports desktop viewports (1280 px and above) and mobile viewports (375 px and above). The default display language is Vietnamese.  
* **Agricultural Expert Dashboard:** A web-based dashboard that allows Agricultural Experts to manage Crop and Variety catalogs, configure Standard Process Templates, handle pre-rental consultation requests, and communicate with Customers and Field Staff through in-app chat channels.  
*  **Field Staff Mobile View:** A mobile-responsive web interface optimized for smartphone use at the farm. It displays the daily task list, task details with step-by-step instructions, a photo upload form for task evidence, and a chat channel to communicate with Agricultural Experts.  
*  **Administrator Dashboard:** A web-based back-office panel that provides Administrators with tools for user account and role management, Plot and Land configuration, Rental and Reservation monitoring, Care Task dispatching, IoT alert configuration, and Audit Log review.

#### **Hardware Interfaces**

*  **IoT Sensor Service (Mock):** Simulated environmental sensors that provide Temperature (in degrees Celsius), Air Humidity (percentage), and Soil Moisture (percentage) readings every 3 hours for each Plot. In the prototype phase, all sensor data is generated programmatically. No physical IoT hardware is connected to the system.  
* **Smartphone Camera:** Field Staff use the built-in camera on their smartphones to capture photographic evidence of task completion. Each photo must not exceed 5 MB in size, and a maximum of 10 photos may be attached per task.

#### **Software Interfaces**

* **OpenWeatherMap API (HTTPS REST / JSON):** Provides 3-to-5-day weather forecast data based on the geographic coordinates of each Plot. The system calls this API when the Plot Detail page loads and when the Customer Dashboard is refreshed.  
* **Payment Gateway – Mock (HTTPS REST / JSON):** Simulates payment transactions with three possible statuses: Pending, Success, and Failed. It handles the full upfront rental payment (100 percent of the total, with no deposit required), Service Request fees, and Temporary Full-care Month Pass purchases.  
* **AI / LLM API with RAG (HTTPS REST / JSON):** Powers the AI Chatbot assistant that answers agricultural questions from Customers. The service accepts user prompts along with contextual data retrieved from the Knowledge Document library managed by Agricultural Experts.  
* **PostgreSQL Database (TCP/IP, port 5432):** The primary relational data store for all system entities, including Users, Plots, Rentals, Care Tasks, and Audit Logs. The database is administered through pgAdmin 4\.

#### **Communication Interfaces**

* **RESTful API (HTTPS, TLS 1.2 or higher):** All communication between the client applications and the server uses JSON payloads over HTTPS RESTful endpoints. The backend is implemented with Java Spring Boot.  
* **Chat Polling (HTTP GET, 5-second interval):** The in-app messaging feature between Customers and Agricultural Experts, as well as between Field Staff and Agricultural Experts, uses HTTP polling at a 5-second interval. Real-time WebSocket communication is deferred to a future release.  
* **Email Service (SMTP or third-party Email API):** Used for sending account registration verification emails, password reset links, and critical system notifications such as Reservation expiry warnings and Payment confirmation receipts.

### **4.2 Quality Attributes**

#### **4.2.1 Usability**

* **Learnability:** A new Customer with no prior training shall be able to browse the Marketplace, select a Plot, and complete a Reservation within 10 minutes on their first use.  
* **Task Efficiency:** A returning Customer who has previously used the system shall be able to complete the entire flow from Reservation to Payment in under 5 minutes.  
* **Field Staff Onboarding:** A newly onboarded Field Staff member shall be able to view assigned tasks, upload photographic evidence, and mark a task as Completed within 3 minutes of basic hands-on training.  
* **Error Guidance:** All form validation errors shall be displayed inline next to the relevant input field, with context-specific messages that clearly indicate the problem and the corrective action required.  
* **Accessibility:** The web application shall meet a minimum of WCAG 2.1 Level A compliance, including sufficient color contrast ratios (at least 4.5 to 1 for normal text), full keyboard navigability for all interactive elements, and appropriate ARIA labels for screen readers.  
* **Responsive Design:** All Customer-facing pages shall render correctly on screen widths ranging from 375 pixels (mobile) to 2560 pixels (ultrawide desktop) without requiring horizontal scrolling or causing content overlap.  
* **Consistent User Interface:** The application shall follow a unified design system using TailwindCSS utility classes and a shared component library to ensure visual consistency across all dashboards for every user role.

#### **4.2.2 Reliability**

* **Availability:** The system shall maintain at least 99.0 percent uptime during operating hours (06:00 to 23:00, GMT+7, daily). Scheduled maintenance is permitted between 02:00 and 05:00 GMT+7, provided that users receive at least 24 hours of advance notification.  
* **Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF):** The system shall achieve an MTBF of at least 720 hours (equivalent to 30 days) for all critical functions, including Reservation creation, Payment processing, and Rental activation.  
* **Mean Time To Repair (MTTR):** In the event of a system failure during operating hours, the development and operations team shall restore normal service within a maximum of 2 hours.  
*  **Data Integrity for Concurrent Reservations:** The system shall use PostgreSQL SERIALIZABLE isolation level combined with SELECT FOR UPDATE locking to prevent double-booking of the same Plot when multiple Customers attempt to create Reservations simultaneously.  
* **Reservation Expiry Accuracy:** The automatic expiry of a Reservation (after 15 minutes) and the Grace Period extension (an additional 10  minutes while the payment status is Pending) shall execute with a timing tolerance of no more than 30 seconds.  
*  **Automatic Task Overdue Detection:** Any Care Task that has not been marked as Completed by 23:59 GMT+7 on its scheduled date shall automatically transition to Overdue status. An alert notification shall be sent to the Administrator within 1 minute of the deadline.  
*  **IoT Data Validation:** Sensor readings that fall outside the plausible environmental range (Temperature below 0 degrees Celsius or above 50 degrees Celsius) shall be automatically filtered out from dashboard displays and logged as data anomalies for Administrator review.  
* **Graceful Degradation for External Services:** If the Weather API or the Payment Gateway becomes temporarily unavailable, the system shall display a user-friendly fallback message and continue operating all other features without data loss.  
* **Defect Rate:** At the time of release, the number of critical defects (defined as complete data loss or a complete inability to use core features such as Rental creation or Payment processing) shall not exceed 0.5 defects per thousand lines of code. Any critical defect discovered after release shall be resolved within 48 hours.

#### **4.2.3 Performance**

**Page Load Time:** The Marketplace listing page and the Customer Dashboard shall fully load and become interactive within 3 seconds when accessed over a standard 4G mobile connection (approximately 10 Mbps).  
**API Response Time:** At least 95 percent of all RESTful API requests shall return a complete response within 500 milliseconds under normal operating load. The maximum acceptable response time for any single API call is 2 seconds.  
**Payment Processing Time:** The end-to-end payment flow, from the moment the Customer submits the payment request to the moment the system receives the gateway callback and activates the Rental, shall complete within 10 seconds.  
**Photo Upload Time:** Uploading a single image file (up to 5 MB in size) shall complete within 5 seconds over a 4G connection. A visual progress indicator shall be displayed to the user during the upload.  
**Chat Message Delivery Latency:** Messages sent through the in-app chat channels shall become visible to the recipient within 5 seconds, corresponding to one polling cycle.  
**Concurrent Users:** The system shall support at least 100 concurrent active users across all roles (Customer, Agricultural Expert, Field Staff, Administrator) without any degradation in response time beyond the targets stated above.  
**Database Capacity:** The system shall support up to 50 active Plots, 500 active Rental contracts, and 10,000 Care Task records simultaneously, with all list and search queries returning results in under 1 second.  
**IoT Data Throughput:** The system shall handle the ingestion of simulated sensor readings for all 50 Plots at a 3-hour cycle (approximately 400 readings per day in total) without any processing backlog or data loss.

#### **4.2.4 Security**

**Authentication:** All users shall authenticate using their registered email address and password. Passwords shall be stored as salted hashes using the BCrypt algorithm with a cost factor of at least 10\. User sessions shall be managed using JSON Web Tokens (JWT) with a configurable expiry period (default: 24 hours).  
**Role-Based Access Control:** The system shall enforce role-based access control with four distinct roles: Customer, Agricultural Expert, Field Staff, and Administrator. Every API endpoint shall validate the requesting user's role before processing the request. Any unauthorized access attempt shall be rejected with an HTTP 403 Forbidden response.  
**Transport Layer Security:** All communication between client applications and the server shall be encrypted using HTTPS with TLS version 1.2 or higher. Any incoming HTTP request shall be automatically redirected to HTTPS.  
**Input Validation and Attack Prevention:** All user-submitted data shall be validated on the server side to prevent common web application attacks, including SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), and Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF). Spring Security CSRF protection shall be enabled for all state-changing API operations.  
 **Data Access Isolation:** Agricultural Experts shall only be able to access Plot data and consultations within their assigned scope. Field Staff shall only be able to view and update Tasks that have been assigned to them. Customers shall only be able to view their own Rental contracts, Payment transactions, Farm Diary entries, and Conversation threads.  
**Secure Password Recovery:** The password reset process shall generate a unique, time-limited token (valid for 15 minutes) that is sent to the user's registered email address. The token shall become invalid after a single use or upon expiry.  
**Audit Trail:** All critical system operations shall be recorded in the Audit Log. Logged operations include Rental creation, Payment transactions, Care Task status changes, User role modifications, and Plot configuration updates. Each log entry shall contain a timestamp, the identity of the actor, the action performed, and the affected entity.  
**File Upload Security:** All uploaded image files shall be validated for permitted MIME types (JPEG and PNG only) and maximum file size (5 MB per file). The system shall reject files that do not meet these criteria and shall scan accepted files for embedded malicious content before storing them on the server.

#### **4.2.5 Supportability and Maintainability**

 **Layered Code Architecture:** The backend application shall follow a layered architecture pattern with clearly separated Controller, Service, and Repository layers to ensure maintainability and testability.  
**API Documentation:** All RESTful API endpoints shall be documented using the Swagger / OpenAPI 3.0 specification. The interactive API documentation shall be accessible at the /api-docs endpoint in development and staging environments.  
**Structured Logging:** The system shall implement structured logging using SLF4J with the Logback framework. Log messages shall be categorized by severity level (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR). All API errors shall be logged with the full request context and stack trace.  
 **Externalized Configuration:** All environment-specific settings, including the database connection URL, third-party API keys, JWT signing secret, and email service credentials, shall be stored in external configuration files and shall never be hard-coded in the source code.  
 **Database Schema Migration:** All database schema changes shall be managed through versioned migration scripts using Flyway or Liquibase to ensure that changes are reproducible, traceable, and consistent across all environments.

## **5\. Requirement Appendix**

*\[Provide business rules, common requirements, or other extra requirements information here\]*

### **5.1 Business Rules** {#5.1-business-rules}

| ID | Rule Definition |
| :---: | ----- |
| BR01 | **Farm Ownership and Operation.** The platform directly owns and operates the farm. Plots are planned and configured before being published for rental. The system does not support customers or external landowners listing land for rent (C2C). |
| BR02 | **Plot Unit.** A Plot is the smallest unit of farmland managed and rented through the system. Each Plot has location, area, technical conditions, an availability calendar, a list of compatible varieties, and IoT data. |
| BR03 | **Approved Varieties and Compatibility.** Customers must select a farm-approved variety compatible with the selected Plot. Customers may not independently bring varieties outside the approved catalog into the farm for cultivation. |
| BR04 | **Minimum Rental Duration.** The rental duration must be equal to or longer than the expected growth duration of the selected variety plus its buffer time. |
| BR05 | **Contract Scope and Per-Plot Configuration.** A contract may include one or more Plots selected by the customer. Each Plot in the contract is configured independently with a compatible variety, start date, end date, and cultivation mode. Plots in the same contract do not have to share the same variety, rental period, or cultivation mode. |
| BR06 | **Site Visits and Pre-rental Consultation.** Guests and prospective customers may book a morning or afternoon farm visit by providing their full name and phone number. Online pre-rental consultation with an Agricultural Expert is optional and is not a prerequisite for booking a Plot. |
| BR07 | **Reservations and Schedule Conflicts.** Only Plots published for rental and available throughout the selected period may be reserved. The rental period must not overlap a confirmed or active contract, an unexpired reservation, or the Plot’s soil-rest period. |
| BR08 | **Reservation Duration and Grace Period.** Each reservation lasts 15 minutes. When the customer proceeds to payment, the reservation changes to pending payment and receives an additional 10-minute grace period. The grace period may be added only once per reservation. |
| BR09 | **Contract Payment.** Customers must pay 100% of the total contract value upfront, including Plot rental charges and care fees applicable to the selected cultivation mode. No deposit is required. |
| BR10 | **Contract Cancellation and Refunds.** Customers must submit a contract cancellation and refund request before the rental start date. The refund depends on the request time:• At least 3 days before the start date: deduct 20% and refund 80% of the amount paid.• Less than 3 days before the start date: deduct 50% and refund 50% of the amount paid.• On or after the rental start date: no refund. |
| BR11 | **Cultivation Modes and Daily Care Packages.** The system supports Self-growing, where customers care for the plants themselves, and Assisted-growing, where the farm provides comprehensive care. Self-growing customers may purchase delegated-care packages for a selected number of days when they cannot care for the plants themselves. |
| BR11b | **Contract Renewal.** Customers may renew a contract if the Plots to be renewed are available during the following period. Renewal must be completed at least 3 days before the contract end date. The current contract remains Active until the end of its rental term, then changes to Renewed after a successful renewal. |
| BR12 | **Standard Cultivation Process by Variety.** Each variety has a standard cultivation process established by an Agricultural Expert. Assisted-growing Plots must fully follow this process; customer-specific process customization is not supported. |
| BR12b | **Guidance for Self-growing Customers.** Self-growing customers may consult the expert’s standard process or choose their own care approach. Self-growing customers may follow the expert's standard process or apply their own customized routine for reference without requiring approval from an Agricultural Expert.  |
| BR14 | **Care Task Assignment and Execution.** Scheduled care tasks and tasks generated from service requests may only be assigned to Field Workers. Tasks not completed by 23:59 on their scheduled date automatically change to Overdue. |
| BR15 | **Task Completion Evidence.** Field Workers must provide at least one actual photograph taken at the Plot before a task can be confirmed as Completed. |
| BR17 | **Farm Diary Synchronization.** When a care task is completed, the system automatically records the performed work and its evidence in the farm diary for the Plot under the corresponding contract. |
| BR18 | **Environmental Data and Action Alerts.** When an environmental alert persists for more than 30 minutes, the system responds according to the cultivation mode:• Assisted-growing: automatically create an urgent care task during 08:00–17:00.• Self-growing: notify the customer and offer an option to request rapid care.When heavy rain is forecast or soil moisture reaches 80% or higher, the system automatically postpones the related watering tasks. |
| BR19 | **AI Assistant.** The AI chatbot helps customers look up general cultivation knowledge, learn about plant diseases, and consult possible treatment methods. |
| BR20 | **Harvest Execution and Recording.** Field Workers harvest the crops, weigh the yield using an electronic scale, take evidence photographs, and upload the results. Customers view and confirm acceptance of the harvest results. |
| BR21 | **Harvest Time and Location.** Harvesting takes place at the farm at the end of the cultivation season. |
| BR22 | **Contract Completion.** Each Plot rental ends on its own end date. Once a Plot rental ends, the system stops generating new cultivation tasks for that Plot but still permits outstanding requests to be handled. Other Plots in the same contract continue according to their respective rental periods. The contract changes to Completed only after all Plot rentals under it have ended. |
| BR23 | **Plot Release and Soil Rest.** After a rental ends without renewal, the Plot changes to Maintenance for cleanup, tilling, and soil drying. The farm decides when soil rest is complete and the Plot can be reopened for rental. |
| BR24 | **Data Access Scope.** Agricultural Experts may access operational data only for their assigned Plots. Field Workers may access only their assigned tasks and the related information needed to carry them out. |
| BR25 | **Communication Channels.** The system supports customer–Agricultural Expert communication for consultation and Field Worker–Agricultural Expert communication for reporting and technical guidance. Customers do not directly assign work to or instruct Field Workers through the system. |
| BR26 | **Purpose of Cultivation Data.** Cultivation data supports monitoring, traceability, and transparency of farm operations. It does not replace legal certification of food safety or organic production. |
| BR27 | **Service Catalog and Care Task Generation.** The farm manages a catalog of per-visit care services and comprehensive delegated-care packages for a customer-selected number of days. After successful service payment, the system automatically creates the corresponding care tasks for assignment to Field Workers. Service prices follow the farm’s configured pricing policy. |
